proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitMechanics.passive.choice_of_grant_bundles
proposed_widenings.justification: Elven Lineage is one species trait that requires a build-time choice among three mutually exclusive lineage bundles. The current passive family can only carry one flat grants list, not a choose-one package of grants.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.

proposed_widenings.name: character_level_gated_passive_grants
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait grants additional spells only when the character reaches levels 3 and 5. Existing passive grants are always on and have no character-level acquisition wrapper for later unlocks.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table.

proposed_widenings.name: long_rest_replace_granted_cantrip_from_spell_list
proposed_widenings.justification: High Elf does not just know a cantrip; it may replace that granted cantrip after each Long Rest with another cantrip from a constrained source list. This needs choose/replace behavior over granted spell access, not a single static grant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spellcasting_ability_choice
proposed_widenings.justification: The granted lineage spells use a chosen spellcasting ability from a closed ability set. Current grant_spell_access can override DC numerically, but it cannot declare the trait's chosen spellcasting ability source for these spells.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

notes: No content file was authored. The unit stays within existing atoms such as grant_sense, modify_speed, and grant_spell_access, but the current surface cannot represent the lineage choice package, later character-level unlocks, or High Elf's long-rest cantrip replacement without misencoding the rule.
